# Northwind Market — Wholesale Price List and Terms

Effective October 1, 2026. These terms apply to business customers (cafés, restaurants, hotels, corporate gift companies and resellers) buying from Northwind Market in Montevideo, Uruguay. All amounts are in Uruguayan pesos (UYU) and exclude VAT (IVA, 22%). Wholesale accounts are opened by our sales team at mayoristas@northwind.example.

## Discount tiers

Wholesale prices are a discount on the current retail list price of each product. The tier depends on the value of each order before VAT:

| Tier | Order value (UYU, excl. VAT) | Discount |
|---|---|---|
| Bronze | 25,000 to 59,999 | 18% off retail |
| Silver | 60,000 to 149,999 | 25% off retail |
| Gold | 150,000 and above | 32% off retail |

Customers who buy more than UYU 900,000 in a calendar year keep the Gold discount on every order the following year, regardless of order size. Tier discounts do not apply to wholesale-only coffee or to items already marked down in the retail outlet.

## Minimum order quantities

- Minimum order: UYU 25,000 before VAT.
- Coffee equipment, cookware and tableware: at least 6 units per SKU.
- Retail coffee bags (250 g and 500 g): at least 24 bags per origin.
- Wholesale-only coffee: at least 10 kg per origin and roast.

Lines below these quantities are billed at the retail price.

## Wholesale-only coffee

Our specialty coffee also comes in 1 kg bags for cafés and restaurants. These are net prices; no tier discount applies:

| Origin | Roast | Price |
|---|---|---|
| Brazil | Medium | UYU 1,420/kg |
| Colombia | Medium | UYU 1,560/kg |
| Ethiopia | Light | UYU 1,980/kg |

Coffee is roasted to order and leaves our warehouse within 72 hours of roasting. Accounts that buy 40 kg or more per month get a free grinder calibration visit every quarter.

## Payment terms

- First three orders: 100% payment in advance by bank transfer.
- From the fourth order: net 30 days from the invoice date, with a credit limit of up to UYU 300,000 approved by our finance team.
- Card payments through Woodgrove Pay carry a 3.5% surcharge.
- Overdue invoices accrue 2% interest per month, and new orders are put on hold until the account is up to date.

## Lead times

| Order type | Lead time |
|---|---|
| In-stock items | Dispatched within 3 business days |
| Wholesale-only coffee | 5 business days (roasted to order) |
| Orders above 200 units | 10 business days |
| Custom-branded packaging or gift boxes | 15 business days after artwork approval |

Branded packaging is printed by Lucerne Impresiones, with a minimum run of 300 boxes.

## Shipping terms

- Delivery is free within Montevideo for orders over UYU 80,000 before VAT; smaller Montevideo orders pay a flat fee of UYU 950.
- Orders to other departments ship freight collect: the customer pays the carrier directly, at cost.
- Customers can collect orders at our warehouse in La Teja on weekdays between 8:00 and 12:00.
- Pallet deliveries need a time slot agreed at least 48 hours in advance. Ownership and risk pass to the customer on delivery.

## Claims

Report missing or damaged items within 3 business days of delivery, with photos and a copy of the delivery note signed with remarks. Approved claims are credited on the next invoice. Wholesale-only coffee cannot be returned; other items in perfect condition can be returned within 15 days with a 15% restocking fee.
